_note: The 100 session icons are not bitmap dot-grids: each is an SVG path (a sigil) traced through a 3x3 lattice, with stroked circle/square end-markers. Generated deterministically by a seeded PRNG at L1164-L1184. All 100 final path strings below were produced by running the exact generator in the browser (Playwright) and verified against the paths rendered in the DOM (seed sessions 0,17,34,51,68,85 all matched).

algorithm.prng: Lehmer / Park-Miller minimal standard: seed=7; rnd = () => (seed = (seed*16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647
steps: G=[3,8,13]; pts=[]; for y in G: for x in G: pts.push([x,y])  // 9 lattice points
while path.length < len: n=floor(rnd()*9); if n not in path: path.push(n)   // distinct points
if seen.has(k) || seen.has(reverse(path).join('')): continue   // dedupe path and its mirror
d += v===2 ? circle(sx,sy,1.9) : v===3 ? square(sx,sy) : circle(sx,sy,0.9)

markers.circle: (x,y,r) => M{x-r} {y} a{r} {r} 0 1 0 {2r} 0 a{r} {r} 0 1 0 {-2r} 0   // full circle subpath (stroked, fill:none => ring)
markers.rules: v=idx%5: 0 => r0.9 circle at start (+ optional r1.6 circle at path[1] if rnd()>0.5); 1 => r0.9 circle at start (closed path if len>3); 2 => r1.9 circle at start; 3 => 2.8 square at start; 4 => r0.9 circle at start AND r0.9 circle at end.

algorithm.prngConsumption: rnd() is called: once per len, once for path[0], once per rejected/added candidate point, plus (for v===0 candidates only) once for the middle-dot coin flip. The coin-flip draw happens in sequence and shifts all later patterns.

rendering.element: <svg width="W" height="W" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="{sigil}"></path></svg>
rendering.stroke: currentColor, width 1.5 (viewBox units), fill:none, round cap+join. NB: markers are stroked outlines (rings/squares), NOT filled dots.
rendering.colorByContext: color = focused ? theme.acc2 : open ? theme.fg : theme.muted  (tile header: focused ? acc2 : fg). No per-dot opacity; single currentColor.
rendering.statusDot: 8x8 circle, border-radius:50%, background = running?acc2 : done?alt : faint, border:2px solid panel/tile
rendering.computedProof: Blood Moon default: focused #d9b56a (acc2), open #f3ead8 (fg/TUNE), unfocused #bfae94 (muted/TUNE). getComputedStyle color matched rgb(217,181,106)/rgb(243,234,216)/rgb(191,174,148).

assignment.initialSeed: state.sessions = seed().map((x,i)=>({...x, icon:[0,17,34,51,68,85][i]}))   // L1191 - 6 sessions get spread-out sigils
assignment.newSession: const used=new Set(sessions.map(x=>x.icon)); let icon=SIGILS.findIndex((_,k)=>!used.has(k)); if(icon<0) icon=sessions.length % SIGILS.length;   // L1273 - first unused index, else round-robin

renderSites.notes: button background = rgba(mix(acc,acc2,(i%6)*0.07), foc?0.42:0.2)  (the accent band); status dot at right:1 bottom:1, border 2px t.panel
status dot at right:-2 bottom:-2, border 2px t.tile

occurrences.wordmark: nav 'archonui' 18px; heading 'Sign in to continue' 36px, text-shadow 0 2px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.7)

identityPresetIcons.location: Settings > Appearance > IDENTITY > Icon  (task brief said General; source places it under Appearance, pg.appearance)
identityPresetIcons.grid: repeat(7, minmax(0,1fr)), gap 8px; each cell aspect-ratio:1, border-radius 8px, image inside at 58% x 58%
identityPresetIcons.list: [...new Set(NAMES.map(nm => THEMES[nm].logo)), ...uploadedIcons]  - 12 theme logos + any user uploads
identityPresetIcons.behavior: pick sets state.logo; selected cell: outline 2px theme.acc, bg theme.soft, else outline transparent, bg theme.line. 'Use theme icon' resets (opacity .4 when already default). '+' label opens a file input (image/*) -> URL.createObjectURL -> appended to upIcons and set as logo.
